map.纵向模量 E_c = V_f*E_f + V_m*E_m（体积分数加权）。碳纤维: Longitudinal modulus E_c = V_f*E_f + V_m*E_m (volume-fraction weighted). Carbon fiber E_f=230GPa at 60%, matrix E_m=3GPa: E_c≈0.6*230+0.4*3=139.2GPa.
map.纵向用算术平均（等应变），横向用调和平均（等应力），分别给出上下界；实际介于其间: Longitudinal uses arithmetic mean (iso-strain), transverse uses harmonic mean (iso-stress), giving upper and lower bounds respectively; actual lies in between.
map.为什么纵向比横向强？: Why is longitudinal stronger than transverse?
map.纵向纤维承力（等应变、算术平均高），横向靠基体传力（等应力、调和平均低），故复合: Longitudinal fiber carries load (iso-strain, high arithmetic mean); transverse relies on matrix transfer (iso-stress, low harmonic mean), so composites are strongly anisotropic.
map.混合法则是精确吗？: Is the rule of mixtures exact?
map.是一阶近似（忽略界面、分布），给出上下界；精确需细观力学模型，但工程估算足够。: It is a first-order approximation (ignoring interface, distribution), giving bounds; exact needs micromechanics models, but engineering estimates suffice.
